item.tib: spyi rje khyung gi gdams pa
item.coloph: de ltar rmi lam 'khrul snang 'di/ yi ger bkod pa bzod par gsol/ 'di bris dge ba'i mthu dang dpal/ stobs dang gzi brjid zil dang gzi/ stong gsum khams gsum srid gsum rje/ zil gnon rgyal po'i sku thob nas/ stong gsum 'jig rten dbang bsgyur zhing / dus gsum mi nub bkra shis shog/
